name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: QoL: verified live on a real server for the first time (rootless container, so it genuinely can't auto-install) that the 'not running as root' Tailscale setup message was correct but unhelpful - it told the admin to 'install it yourself' without saying how. The environment check now also returns a copy-pasteable install command (curl -fsSL https://tailscale.com/install.sh | sudo sh) for that specific case, shown with a one-click Copy button on the config page. Left the other failure reasons (non-Linux, missing /dev/net/tun) as explanatory text only - unlike the root case, neither reduces to a single command without knowing the rest of the admin's own setup, so a fabricated one would mislead rather than help. 301 tests, all green, run 2x.
